svg.aria-label: Sebastián Elustondo. Software engineer, Buenos Aires. A building at night with five lit windows, one per product.

g.text: Software engineer, Buenos Aires. Days at the day job, nights on my own products.

text.tspan: Six years on production platforms (Mercado Libre, Conekta, Spin, Kleva):
Node, TypeScript, multi-tenant PostgreSQL, AWS, payments. That's daytime.
After dark I design, build and run complete products alone.

text.font-family: 'Azeret Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Buenos Aires · full overlap with US hours
Five windows are lit. Each one is a product I built and still run.
